description: Tráfico de servicios de telecomunicaciones is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by URSEC. Datos de tráfico de voz y datos de los servicios de telefonía fija y móvil en Uruguay. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher URSEC. Its tags are Fija, Móvil, Telecomunicaciones, Telefonía, Tráfico. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-02-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
